title: drupilot reproducibility lockfile (drupilot-lock.json)
description: The per-project lockfile that freezes what drupilot resolved (DRUPILOT_DETERMINISTIC). It lives in the hidden state dir of the Drupal ROOT (drupilot_lock_file: project_state_dir of the root, under drupilot's data dir), never in the project tree. It is built key by key: the lock_set (string), lock_set_json (raw JSON) and lock_merge_json (several keys in one write) helpers of scripts/lib/lock.sh create it as {"schema": 1} on first write (a lock without schema was created by drupilot 0.9) and stamp drupilot_version on every write; scripts/env/lock-sync.sh writes the metadata, php_target, phpstan_level, core_strategy, drupal.core, toolchain.* and ddev_addons.* (and --refresh deletes digests.sha); scripts/analysis/run-rector.sh writes digests.ref/sha; scripts/analysis/verify-core-matrix.sh writes verify_cores.*; scripts/env/install-toolchain.sh re-runs lock-sync.sh and records toolchain_cell; scripts/analysis/upgrade-path.sh --freeze writes upgrade_plan, upgrade_plan_hash, upgrade_plan_phase and data_hash in one write (ADR 0018). Every section is optional: a lock holds only what was frozen so far.

drupilot_version.description: plugin.json's version of the drupilot that last wrote the lock (stamped by every lock_set / lock_set_json).

drupilot_revision.description: git describe of the drupilot checkout that ran lock-sync.sh; removed again when drupilot runs from an installed copy.

created.description: UTC timestamp of the first lock-sync.sh run (a lock first written by run-rector.sh or verify-core-matrix.sh has none until then).

updated.description: UTC timestamp of the last lock-sync.sh run.

php_target.description: The effective DRUPILOT_PHP_TARGET at the last lock-sync.sh run.

phpstan_level.description: The effective DRUPILOT_PHPSTAN_LEVEL (an int setting), written as raw JSON by lock_set_json.

core_strategy.description: The effective DRUPILOT_CORE_TARGET_STRATEGY as configured (auto, d11-only, keep-d10; not validated before it is written).

core.description: Exact drupal/core (else drupal/core-recommended) version from composer.lock.

toolchain.description: {composer package: exact version from composer.lock} for each config/defaults.json .packages entry that is installed.

schema.description: The lock format: 1 for a lock drupilot 1.0 created (lock_set / lock_set_json start it as {"schema": 1}); absent (0) for one drupilot 0.9 created.

runtime_hash.description: The hash of the PHP helpers stage_runtime staged into <root>/.drupilot/runtime/ (scripts/php/*.php: the sorted "name sha256" lines, json_hash), from 1.0 (AR-23).

lenient_packages.description: The packages mglaman/composer-drupal-lenient lets install on the test-bed despite their drupal/core constraint, as its composer.json allowed-list has them (lenient_packages; ["*"] with allow-all), recorded by install-toolchain.sh when DRUPILOT_LENIENT_DEPS was used (AR-14, AR-28).

toolchain_cell.description: The cell of config/toolchain-reference.json the toolchain was installed from (install-toolchain.sh, from 1.0). A lock that pins rector/rector without it was written by drupilot 0.9 and is read as cell legacy_v1 until it is refreshed.

ddev_addons.description: Installed DDEV add-on versions ("installed" when the version is unknown); only add-ons found in the project.

digests.description: The dbuytaert/drupal-digests checkout frozen by run-rector.sh after a digests pass finished normally; lock-sync.sh --refresh drops sha.

sha.description: The commit the ref resolved to.

implemented_yml_sha256.description: The file_hash of drupal-rector's docs/implemented-digests.yml at the installed version, the digests rules drupal-rector already implements (03-R17), frozen by run-rector.sh at the first digests pass.

implemented_yml_ref.description: The drupal-rector version (git tag) that yml was fetched at.

upgrade_plan.description: The frozen upgrade plan (schemas/upgrade-plan.schema.json, kept whole with its meta) that every stage reads its versions from through plan_get (ADR 0018).

upgrade_plan_hash.description: sha256 of the plan's canonical JSON without meta (canon_json_hashable | json_hash).

upgrade_plan_phase.description: The phase of the frozen plan: draft (setup, static signals) or final (port, with the analyzer signal).

data_hash.description: The version data the frozen plan was resolved with (the plan's own data_hash).

templates.description: The configs drupilot rendered, keyed by their path under the root (rector.php, rector-compat.php, phpstan.neon, ...): the sha256 of the file as written and the template version (render_sha_record; ADR 0019). A file whose sha256 is the kept one is an untouched render, regenerated when the plan moves; any other content is hand-edited (INV5).

verify_cores.description: Reference Drupal cores frozen by verify-core-matrix.sh, keyed by leg (e.g. "10", "10.0", "10.3"); each value is {constraint, version}, both strings (the composer constraint the leg resolved and the exact core it got).
